description: Boundary and special-value coverage for the Patch record wire round trip: a fully-populated record with a non-empty extra metadata map, a negative apply depth, a zero depth alongside an explicitly-set sha256/extra, a record with only an extra map set (sha256/depth unset -> null), and a record carrying non-ASCII (unicode) text in its description and url. The output lists each field of the record reconstructed from its own serialized wire form.

cases.expected_output:
package=vendor/pkg
description=desc with spaces & = signs
url=/local/path/to.patch
sha256=abc123
depth=3
extra={"provenance":"root","weight":5}

package=a/b
description=neg depth
url=https://example.com/p.patch
sha256=null
depth=-1
extra=[]

package=x/y
description=d
url=u
sha256=null
depth=null
extra={"k":"v"}

package=u/n
description=unicode café
url=http://h/é.patch
sha256=ff
depth=null
extra=[]
